support.watchout: Riktor, Dekker, Mourn, Narbash and Phase win this lane on our sim; don't Imperial Lash in first, hold Queen's Garden for their engage.

offlane.watchout: Every listed offlaner wins this lane on our sim; against Greystone or Steel, farm under your tower instead of dashing in first.
Greystone, Steel, Scarlett and Aurora win this lane on our sim; poke with Hellfire and skip all-ins until your jungler arrives.

midlane.watchout: Every listed midlaner wins this lane on our sim; farm from max range and keep Ether Crystal to push divers off you.

support.watchout: Riktor, Dekker, Mourn and Narbash win this lane on our sim; hide behind minions and save Dread Nova to stun whoever engages.

offlane.watchout: Greystone wins this lane on our sim; don't start fights into him, farm safely and save Hoarfrost to root him when he engages.

jungle.watchout: Kwang wins this matchup on our sim; don't duel him in the jungle, gank lanes or take objectives on the far side.

support.watchout: Glacial Charge is also your main escape; never spend it to engage while your carry is out of position.

offlane.watchout: Greystone, Steel, Scarlett, Aurora and Crunch win this lane on our sim; farm safely and only Skull Crusher in with your jungler close.

jungle.watchout: Khaimera, Serath, Kwang and Feng Mao win this matchup on our sim; don't duel them, gank lanes and trade objectives instead.
Khaimera, Serath, Kwang, Yurei and Feng Mao win this matchup on our sim; don't duel them, gank lanes where your laner can follow.

midlane.watchout: Gideon wins this lane on our sim; don't Shadow Slip into him first, farm safely and save Feast for when he's already low.

offlane.watchout: Greystone wins this lane on our sim; keep trades short and recast Shadow Slip to swap out before he answers.

jungle.watchout: Feast leaps you into their team; only use it while Shadow Slip is ready to swap you back out.

support.line: Open with Stasis Bomb from a distance for a longer stun, then Photon Disruptor to slow and Containment Fence to trap them with your carry. Once Stonewall and Inquisition are done by minute 18, stand in front and drop Ion Strike so its center stuns.
support.watchout: A badly placed Containment Fence can block your own carry's chase; fence behind them, never between them and your team.

carry.line: Open with Old Rusty to slow, throw Gag Grenade to silence them, then Rad Rounds for fast basic attacks and Shrapnel Cannon to shred armor. Once Deathstalker completes around minute 16, keep attacking in longer fights and fire Shrapnel Cannon mid-air to escape dives.
carry.watchout: Murdock wins this lane on our sim; don't trade inside his range, farm safely and save Shrapnel Cannon's mid-air launch for his engage.

carry.line: Poke in ranged stance with Tachyon Lance, then Zero Shift to melee, Talon Drive in and spin Axiom Strike to build Heat for Limit Break. Once Viper completes around minute 16, stay in longer fights, since melee stance heals you off hero damage.
carry.watchout: Murdock and Drongo win this lane on our sim; stay ranged, farm safely and only go melee after your support lands a stun.

offlane.line: Trade in ranged stance with Tachyon Lance and Sidewind, then Zero Shift to melee and Talon Drive in once they're low, keeping damage flowing to build Heat. Once Viper completes around minute 16, take longer fights in melee stance to heal off hero damage.
offlane.watchout: Greystone, Steel, Scarlett and Aurora win this lane on our sim; stay in ranged stance and only go melee with your jungler nearby.

midlane.line: Poke in ranged stance with Tachyon Lance and Sidewind's empowered Railshot, then Zero Shift to melee and Talon Drive onto a low target. Once Viper completes around minute 16, roam in melee stance and keep hitting heroes so Heat builds toward Limit Break.
midlane.watchout: Renna, Lt. Belica, Valmont, Gideon and Iggy & Scorch win this lane on our sim; stay ranged, farm with Tachyon Lance and skip all-ins.

jungle.watchout: Khaimera and Kwang win this matchup on our sim; don't duel them, gank lanes and save Safeguard to block their key ability.

offlane.watchout: Greystone, Steel, Scarlett and Aurora win this lane on our sim; farm safely and only dash in when your jungler is coming.

midlane.watchout: Gideon wins this lane on our sim; farm from max range and save Security Gate to root him when he engages.

support.watchout: You have no dash; when they dive, run your carry through Security Gate for the speed boost and root the chaser.

offlane.watchout: You have no dash to escape a gank; keep Security Gate ready to root whoever dives you.

midlane.watchout: Black Hole locks you in place while it channels; cast it behind your frontline, never as the opener.

offlane.watchout: A missed Assault The Gates leaves you stranded with no way out; leap only when your follow-up is ready.

jungle.watchout: Kwang wins this matchup on our sim; don't duel him in the jungle, gank lanes or take objectives on the far side.

carry.watchout: GTFO slows you while you lock on; fire it only when nobody can reach you.

offlane.watchout: You're fragile up close; if they dive you, drop Land Mine at your feet to knock them away.

midlane.watchout: Gideon and The Fey win this lane on our sim; play behind your turrets and don't push past them without your jungler.

offlane.watchout: Greystone wins this lane on our sim; fight beside your turrets, never away from them, and save Inferno's belch to knock him back.

support.watchout: Dekker wins this lane on our sim; keep turrets behind your minions and don't chase her through the wave.

carry.watchout: A missed Narcosis leaves nothing to stop divers; back off until it's ready again.

midlane.watchout: Gideon and Iggy & Scorch win this lane on our sim; farm with Brine from range and save Narcosis for their engage.

support.watchout: Dekker wins this lane on our sim; stay behind your minions, poke with Brine and hold Narcosis until she commits.

jungle.watchout: Khaimera and Kwang win this matchup on our sim; never duel them head-on, gank lanes and pick off isolated targets instead.
Kwang wins this matchup on our sim; don't start a fair duel with him, gank lanes or fight him with a laner beside you.

offlane.watchout: Greystone, Steel and Aurora win this lane on our sim; farm safely and only Ambush when your jungler is close.

carry.line: Stack Vengeance with basic attacks and Mercy, then Dusk to pop the stacks and slow, keeping Shadow Glide to dodge or chase. Once Deathstalker completes around minute 16, use Purge in fights to cut enemy healing while you shred them.
carry.watchout: Shadow Glide is your only escape; keep it ready before you commit to Purge.

jungle.line: Throw Judgement of the Heavens to tether them, Surge of the Heavens near the Blade to recall it and knock them up, then Fury of the Heavens to slow. Once Prophecy completes around minute 15, weave basic attacks while your Blade is Energized.
jungle.watchout: Fury of the Heavens teleports you to the Blade if it's out; check where it landed before you cast.

offlane.line: Throw Judgement of the Heavens to tether, use Light of the Heavens for the shield, then Surge of the Heavens back to the Blade for the knock-up. Once Prophecy completes around minute 16, trade longer with Energized basic attacks.

support.line: Tether their carry with Judgement of the Heavens, Surge of the Heavens near the Blade to knock them up, then Fury of the Heavens. After Stonewall and Raiment of Renewal are done by minute 19, front up and shield with Light of the Heavens.
support.watchout: Light of the Heavens only shields while you hold the Blade; recall it before their engage, not after.

carry.line: Fire Saturation Charge to slow, then follow with basic attacks and an Orbital Sanction that tracks them, keeping Frag Order to launch yourself away. Once Spectra completes around minute 15, drop Rally Point in fights to heal and speed your team.
carry.watchout: Every listed carry wins this lane on our sim; farm safely, keep Frag Order ready to escape, and let your support start fights.

midlane.watchout: Every listed midlaner wins this lane on our sim; farm from range, keep Frag Order for escape and wait for your jungler before trading.

offlane.watchout: Every listed offlaner wins this lane on our sim; farm under your tower and use Frag Order to launch away from their engage.

midlane.watchout: Gideon, Iggy & Scorch and The Fey win this lane on our sim; farm from range and save Seismic Assault for their engage.

support.watchout: Dekker wins this lane on our sim; drop Void Drone for vision, stay behind your carry, and save Seismic Assault for whoever dives.

midlane.watchout: Against Gideon this lane loses on paper; farm with Hive from range and save Swarm to escape instead of diving in.

offlane.watchout: Curse only hits a marked target; if nobody is marked, don't dive with Swarm, back off until Mark is ready again.

support.watchout: Against Riktor or Dekker, don't channel Abduct out in the open; stay behind your carry and use Beguile to stop whoever dives.

offlane.watchout: Against Greystone, Steel, Scarlett or Aurora this lane loses on paper; farm near your tower and save Beguile for when they dive.

carry.line: Set Static Trap where they walk, poke with basic attacks until Shots Fired is ready, then blast with RMB Buckshot and chase with E Hot Pursuit. Once Viper and Deathstalker are done around minute 16, stand and trade basic attacks longer.
carry.watchout: Kneeling for Long Arm of the Law with nobody in front of you gets you killed; fire it from behind your team.

offlane.line: Set Static Trap at your feet, poke with basic attacks until Shots Fired is ready, and push divers off you with RMB Buckshot. Once Viper and Deathstalker are done around minute 16, stand and trade basic attacks longer.

support.watchout: Against Riktor, Dekker or Mourn, don't stand in front charging Serenity; stay behind your carry and shield first.

support.line: Stun with RMB Thunk, use Q March! to rush your team in or out, then start R Crash Bang Boom! in the middle of the fight. Once Wraith Leggings and Oblivion Crown are done around minute 20, you can stay in fights longer.
support.watchout: Against Riktor or Dekker this lane loses on paper; keep Thunk to stop their engage instead of opening with it.

midlane.watchout: Lt. Belica, Gideon, Iggy & Scorch and The Fey all beat this lane on paper; farm from range and hold Stupor for whoever dives you.

carry.watchout: Sparrow, TwinBlast, Murdock and Drongo beat this lane on paper; farm behind your support and save Air Assault to dodge their trades.

carry.line: Slow them with Q Hail of Arrows, keep basic attacking to stack Relentless, then fire RMB Piercing Shot; use E Heightened Senses to reset a bad trade. Once Viper and Deathstalker are done around minute 16, open fights with R Inner Fire.

offlane.watchout: Against Greystone or Aurora this lane loses on paper; farm near your tower and save Bull Rush to escape instead of engaging.

support.watchout: Against Dekker this lane loses on paper; stay beside your carry and keep Force Shield up for them instead of rushing in.
